summary: The legacy workspace document, written as a projection of the focused profile so the older release still opens the same V, layout and looks.
idempotency: The text's hash: unchanged text is never rewritten.

x-friction.gap: The mirror is a derived value written out debounced, only when changed, trimmed to a size budget, with quota refusals coming back as observations; engine sinks take committed entries by type.
x-friction.closes: Outputs fed by derived values, debounced, within a size budget, with refusals observed.
